title: Nixify ai-ticket Python project
prompt:
Create a Nix flake for the ai-ticket Python project located at /mnt/data1/2023/09/24/ai-ticket.

Requirements:
1. Package as Python application using buildPythonApplication
2. Include all dependencies: requests, flask, github, openai
3. Create development shell with Python 3.11
4. Add scripts: ai-ticket-server, ai-ticket-cli
5. Make it runnable with: nix run .#ai-ticket

Output:
- zos/ai-ticket/flake.nix
- zos/ai-ticket/default.nix (if needed)
- Test with: nix build .#ai-ticket

Context: This is Phase 1 of migrating ai-ticket to ZOS. The Python version will be replaced with Rust in Phase 2.
